contracts: Starting play hides the contextual dock while preserving objective and CASE CHAIN.
Dialogue choices reopen the dock, remain actionable, and emit the chosen identifier.
The real controller dismissal clears choices and portrait and keeps the dock closed.
HUD refresh and true-to-false letterbox return do not resurrect the dismissed dock.
Tutorial, evidence-board, feedback and ending overlays retain their independent behavior.
Both import and execution use the existing fail-closed _run_godot helper with bounded 300s/60s timeouts and only the existing macOS host-error allowance.
A real push_error script and a real GDScript assertion-error script each print a passing result marker and exit zero; the wrapper rejects both as RuntimeError exit=0.
